text:
marta: Quick copy + accessibility check on the "Session expired" modal in Console — mock uploaded. Need 2-line body, primary CTA choices: `Reauthenticate` vs `Sign in`, and a secondary action to keep viewing. Also thinking about keyboard focus & screen-reader hints. Quick takes? :eyes: kevin: I prefer `Sign in` — shorter and consistent with other flows. `Reauthenticate` sounds a bit technical. :+1: jaspreet: Agree on `Sign in`. Also the body copy: `Your session ended for security reasons` feels vague. Suggest: `Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue editing.` keeps it clear and action-oriented. luis-a11y: A11y notes: use `role="alertdialog"` on the modal and an `aria-describedby` id for the explanation text. Make sure focus moves to the primary CTA on open. Esc should close the dialog. Contrast check on the secondary button — needs AA. For SR announce, prefer the dialog role rather than `aria-live="polite"` for reliability. marta: Good calls. Secondary action wording — options: `Continue read-only`, `View in read-only mode`, or `View read-only`. Thoughts on brevity vs clarity? kevin: Short + clear wins. `View in read-only mode` is explicit for users who might be confused. But may be long on small screens. jaspreet: I like `View in read-only mode` for clarity; for mobile we can truncate with ellipsis but ensure SR sees full text via `aria-label` if we shorten visually. luis-a11y: If you shorten visually, add `aria-label="View in read-only mode"` on the button so screen readers get the full phrase. Also prefer active voice: `Continue in read-only` is slightly awkward. `View in read-only mode` is fine. marta: Proposed final copy: Title: `Session expired` Body: `Your session has expired. Sign in again to keep editing your workspace.` Primary CTA: `Sign in` Secondary CTA: `View in read-only mode` SR notes: `role="alertdialog"`, `aria-describedby="session-expired-desc"`, focus set to Sign in, add `aria-label` on secondary if we visually shorten. Any objections? kevin: No objections. Also: if we show a countdown elsewhere, don't include time language here — confusing. Just state expired. jaspreet: I'll update the React modal. Patch snippet for reviewer: ```jsx

Session expired

Your session has expired. Sign in again to keep editing your workspace.

 ``` luis-a11y: :white_check_mark: LGTM. Small nit: `Sign in again` as primary label might communicate intent better than `Sign in`, but I won't block on it — consistency matters. marta: Thanks all — I'll update Figma and the copy tokens, then upload the final mock and ping product for the release note. Marking this resolved for now. :sparkles: design-bot: Thread archived after 1 day of inactivity.
